name: Shop Outreach — поиск заведений и продающее письмо
description: Агент поиска B2B-лидов для меню-платформы: генерирует поисковые запросы по предприятиям общепита города, краулит сайты и страницы контактов, извлекает email, дедуплицирует через CRM entities (entity_type=lead) и шлёт продающее HTML-письмо из доступного ящика компании через mail_send. По умолчанию dry-run: переменная send_enabled включает реальную отправку, test_recipient направляет весь прогон на один тестовый адрес. Бренд/отправитель/шаблон — переменные flow, перенастраиваются под любую компанию без правки кода.

import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

_EMAIL_RE = r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}"
_URL_RE = r"https?://[^\s<>'\"\)\]]+"


def _variables(state):
    raw = state.variables
    return dict(raw) if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}


def _bool(value, default=False):
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
    return bool(value)


async def run(args, state):
    variables = _variables(state)
    send_enabled = _bool(variables.get("send_enabled"), False)
    test_recipient = str(variables.get("test_recipient") or "").strip().lower()
    if test_recipient and not re.fullmatch(_EMAIL_RE, test_recipient):
        raise ValueError("test_recipient не является валидным email: " + test_recipient)

    content = str(state.get("content") or "")
    seed_emails = []
    for match in re.finditer(_EMAIL_RE, content):
        address = match.group(0).strip().lower()
        if address != test_recipient and address not in seed_emails:
            seed_emails.append(address)

    seed_urls = []
    for match in re.finditer(_URL_RE, content, re.IGNORECASE):
        url = match.group(0).rstrip(".,;")
        if url not in seed_urls:
            seed_urls.append(url)

    today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    session_id = str(state.get("session_id") or "manual")
    state["campaign_id"] = "outreach:" + session_id + ":" + today
    state["send_enabled"] = send_enabled
    state["test_recipient"] = test_recipient
    state["seed_mode"] = len(seed_emails) > 0
    seed_leads = [
        {
            "email": address,
            "business_name": "",
            "business_type": "",
            "source_url": "",
            "page_url": "",
            "confidence": 1.0,
        }
        for address in seed_emails
    ]
    state["seed_leads"] = seed_leads
    state["seed_urls"] = seed_urls
    state["leads"] = list(seed_leads)
    state["leads_to_send"] = []
    state["skipped_leads"] = []
    state["send_results"] = []
    state["node_errors"] = []
    return state

_FINAL_STATUSES = {"sent", "suppressed"}


async def run(args, state):
    variables = dict(state.variables) if isinstance(state.variables, dict) else {}
    entity_type = str(variables.get("crm_entity_type") or "lead").strip()
    namespace = str(variables.get("crm_namespace") or "").strip() or None
    campaign_id = str(state.get("campaign_id") or "")
    max_leads = int(variables.get("max_leads") or 25)

    errors = list(state.get("node_errors") or [])
    to_send = []
    skipped = []

    for lead in list(state.get("leads") or [])[:max_leads]:
        email = lead["email"]
        existing = None
        existing_status = ""
        existing_description = ""
        try:
            hits = await tools.crm_search_entities(
                query=email, entity_type=entity_type, namespace=namespace, limit=5
            )
            for hit in hits.get("hits") or []:
                probe = str(hit.get("name") or "") + " " + str(hit.get("description") or "")
                if email in probe:
                    existing = hit
                    break
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append("crm_search:" + email + ": " + str(exc)[:200])

        if existing is not None:
            entity_id = str(existing.get("entity_id") or "")
            try:
                full = await tools.crm_get_entity(entity_id=entity_id)
                entity = full.get("entity") or {}
                existing_status = str(entity.get("status") or "").strip().lower()
                existing_description = str(entity.get("description") or "")
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append("crm_get:" + email + ": " + str(exc)[:200])
            if existing_status in _FINAL_STATUSES:
                skipped.append({"email": email, "reason": "status:" + existing_status, "entity_id": entity_id})
                continue
            lead["entity_id"] = entity_id
            lead["entity_description"] = existing_description
            to_send.append(lead)
            continue

        name = str(lead.get("business_name") or "").strip() or email
        description = (
            email + " | " + str(lead.get("site_domain") or "")
            + " | source: " + str(lead.get("source_url") or "")
        )
        try:
            created = await tools.crm_create_entity(
                entity_type=entity_type,
                name=name,
                entity_subtype=str(lead.get("business_type") or "").strip() or None,
                namespace=namespace,
                description=description,
                attributes={
                    "email": email,
                    "website": str(lead.get("site_domain") or ""),
                    "source_url": str(lead.get("source_url") or ""),
                    "confidence": lead.get("confidence"),
                    "outreach_campaign": campaign_id,
                },
                tags=["outreach", campaign_id, str(lead.get("business_type") or "other")],
            )
            entity = created.get("entity") or {}
            lead["entity_id"] = str(entity.get("entity_id") or "")
            lead["entity_description"] = description
            to_send.append(lead)
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append("crm_create:" + email + ": " + str(exc)[:200])
            skipped.append({"email": email, "reason": "crm_error"})

    state["leads_to_send"] = to_send
    state["skipped_leads"] = skipped
    state["node_errors"] = errors
    return state

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def _render(template, lead, variables, campaign_marker):
    name = str(lead.get("business_name") or "").strip()
    if not name:
        name = str(lead.get("name_hint") or "").strip() or "ваше заведение"
    out = template
    out = out.replace("{{business_name}}", name)
    out = out.replace("{{landing_url}}", str(variables.get("landing_url") or ""))
    out = out.replace("{{sender_display_name}}", str(variables.get("sender_display_name") or ""))
    out = out.replace("{{campaign_marker}}", campaign_marker)
    return out


async def run(args, state):
    variables = dict(state.variables) if isinstance(state.variables, dict) else {}
    campaign_id = str(state.get("campaign_id") or "")
    template_html = str(variables.get("email_template_html") or "")
    template_text = str(variables.get("email_text_template") or "")
    subject_template = str(variables.get("email_subject_template") or "")
    if not template_html.strip() or not template_text.strip():
        raise ValueError("email_template_html/email_text_template обязательны")

    leads = list(state.get("leads_to_send") or [])
    rendered = []
    for lead in leads:
        marker = campaign_id + "/" + lead["email"]
        rendered.append(
            {
                "email": lead["email"],
                "entity_id": lead.get("entity_id") or "",
                "entity_description": lead.get("entity_description") or "",
                "business_name": str(lead.get("business_name") or "").strip(),
                "subject": _render(subject_template, lead, variables, marker),
                "body_text": _render(template_text, lead, variables, marker),
                "body_html": _render(template_html, lead, variables, marker),
            }
        )

    state["rendered_emails"] = rendered
    found = len(state.get("leads") or [])
    skipped = list(state.get("skipped_leads") or [])
    rejected = list(state.get("rejected_leads") or [])
    stats = {
        "send_enabled": bool(state.get("send_enabled")),
        "test_recipient": str(state.get("test_recipient") or ""),
        "found": found,
        "rejected": len(rejected),
        "to_send": len(leads),
        "skipped": skipped,
        "sent": 0,
        "failed": 0,
        "errors": list(state.get("node_errors") or []),
        "leads": [
            {
                "email": item["email"],
                "business_name": item.get("business_name") or "",
                "business_type": item.get("business_type") or "",
            }
            for item in rendered
        ],
        "preview_subject": rendered[0]["subject"] if rendered else "",
        "preview_body_text": rendered[0]["body_text"][:1200] if rendered else "",
    }
    state["run_stats_json"] = json.dumps(stats, ensure_ascii=False)
    return state

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone


async def run(args, state):
    variables = dict(state.variables) if isinstance(state.variables, dict) else {}
    max_sends = int(variables.get("max_sends_per_run") or 10)
    sender_local_part = str(variables.get("sender_local_part") or "").strip() or None
    sender_display_name = str(variables.get("sender_display_name") or "").strip() or None
    test_recipient = str(state.get("test_recipient") or "").strip() or None

    rendered = list(state.get("rendered_emails") or [])
    if test_recipient:
        rendered = rendered[:1]
    else:
        rendered = rendered[:max_sends]

    results = []
    errors = list(state.get("node_errors") or [])
    sent_ok = 0
    for item in rendered:
        to = [test_recipient] if test_recipient else [item["email"]]
        record = {"to": to[0], "lead_email": item["email"], "ok": False}
        try:
            res = await tools.mail_send(
                to_addresses=to,
                subject=item["subject"],
                body_text=item["body_text"],
                body_html=item["body_html"],
                from_local_part=sender_local_part,
                sender_display_name=sender_display_name,
            )
            record["ok"] = True
            record["message_id"] = str(res.get("message_id") or "")
            record["from_address"] = str(res.get("from_address") or "")
            sent_ok += 1
        except Exception as exc:
            record["error"] = str(exc)[:300]
            errors.append("mail_send:" + item["email"] + ": " + str(exc)[:200])
        results.append(record)

        entity_id = item.get("entity_id") or ""
        if entity_id:
            audit = "sent " + datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            if record.get("message_id"):
                audit += " message_id=" + record["message_id"]
            if record.get("error"):
                audit += " error=" + record["error"][:160]
            base_desc = item.get("entity_description") or item["email"]
            try:
                await tools.crm_update_entity(
                    entity_id=entity_id,
                    status="sent" if record["ok"] else "send_failed",
                    description=base_desc + "\n" + audit,
                )
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append("crm_update:" + item["email"] + ": " + str(exc)[:200])

    stats = json.loads(str(state.get("run_stats_json") or "{}"))
    stats["sent"] = sent_ok
    stats["failed"] = len(results) - sent_ok
    stats["send_results"] = results
    stats["errors"] = errors
    state["send_results"] = results
    state["node_errors"] = errors
    state["run_stats_json"] = json.dumps(stats, ensure_ascii=False)
    return state
